# Pullfrog bot-authored PR canary

Repository: `fr-meyer/agent-toolkit`

This disposable documentation-only change verifies that a fresh pull request opened by `mergeguez[bot]` receives an automatic Pullfrog review plus exact-head `pullfrog` and `pullfrog-approval` checks.

The pull request must be closed without merging after evidence is collected. Its source branch must be retained unless separately authorized for deletion.
